name: What can go wrong if my custom cabinet layout is not coordinated with plumbing and electrical?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if my custom cabinet layout is not coordinated with plumbing and electrical?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Do not approve a cabinet layout until the sink, dishwasher, refrigerator, range, hood, and major prep areas have been checked together. Small shifts can affect plumbing, electrical circuits, ventilation, countertop seams, and cabinet widths.

Context: Kitchen remodeling combines several trades, so a cabinet plan that looks correct in isolation may conflict with utilities or appliance installation requirements. Elite Remodeling & Design coordinates design and construction stages for this reason.

Key factors:
- Work flow and landing areas
- Utility locations and access
- Appliance ventilation and clearances
- Countertop support and seam placement

Practical guidance: Review elevations and a floor plan with appliances shown at actual sizes. Ask who confirms field conditions before cabinets are ordered.

A coordinated plan helps prevent field cutting, awkward fillers, and rework.
acceptedAnswer.description: Poor coordination can create appliance conflicts, insufficient outlets, ventilation problems, awkward fillers, countertop issues, and costly rework. Review appliance specifications, utilities, elevations, and field measurements before fabrication.
